Current remote frontend API composes connection, lease/control, recovery, replay and replacement-service rebinding capabilities. create_session keeps design-bound creation on the existing command lane; create_ciw_session requests the service-side CIW capture and returns the same published session/control receipt without exposing host handles. fork_session is an explicit user action that asks the service to create one read-only view child under the addressed parent runtime; it carries no CellKey, grants no new write path and reuses the same command/control receipt. ask_head exposes a read-only durable receipt with the live queue head for advisory wake validation; object_source exposes bounded read-only selection/object/window/highlight queries without acquiring control or opening a target. target_source exposes the target-picker facade only for live sessions; library/cell/view reads use target_lookup while open_design_target remains an explicit command requiring the existing control proof and waiting audit identity. object_instances enumerates reachable other project bridges without guessing, including an empty window list when the target is not open. highlight_object_instance is an explicit user-selected view action requiring the existing control proof. open_object_target is an explicit user-confirmed view action that requires the existing control proof, accepts an optional explicitly selected candidate, and opens the referenced cellview read-only on that instance. navigation_labels submits project-level label commands through the existing command lane without exposing label storage, controllers or a second write path. write_lease is the only handoff of write authority: it addresses the owner session, requires the existing control proof, and delegates grant_write/revoke_write/answer_write_request without exposing the lease registry or adding a second write path; answering a request is what lets the requesting reader's card be confirmed from that same window. Task start also carries the explicit-settings marker beside the frozen turn options so the transcript can distinguish a default snapshot from a user selection. Context-mode profile selection and the effective selection-tool capability are passed to the task driver without changing task ownership. CCL1-D adds a host policy check at the real session owner before each task admission and connection, including retained runtimes; TaskDriver receives no journal-root assumptions or second workspace state. The instruction alias remains the same object.

Current automatic product envelope and scope recording, with explicit session choices retained for embeddings and CI. SICO_CONTEXT_MODE selects desktop_context for new sessions; restored desktop_context is preserved and restored desktop_compat is not silently widened. Legacy project/default/migration records are migrated once to the selected automatic surface, legacy tool-profile.json is no longer consumed by product sessions, and bound runtime selection cannot change.
records: ProfileSetting task-bearing journal without profile event

reviews.rationale: Generated immutable inventory for the frozen desktop_compat surface. tool_profiles imports this one declaration; the module does not resolve profiles, select sessions or provide a second capability authority. Later tools belong in explicit task profiles.

Single host-profile declaration table. adaptive is derived from mixed_design plus pdk_maintenance; mixed_design remains an explicit design-only envelope, desktop_compat is the generated frozen compatibility surface, desktop_context is the explicit context-mode envelope combining that frozen surface with the bounded selection and one-level hierarchy readers, and verification keeps its separate whitelist. simulation keeps simulation_job action=inspect|status|stop|release as its convenience entry while the shared simulation_run group uses the bounded lifecycle tools that the frozen desktop surface also serves; legacy lifecycle names remain only on desktop_compat. prepare_library is the canonical circuit-profile library preflight; prepare_circuit_library remains a hidden compatibility alias. plan_copilot_stages records ordered pre-execution stage plans in the circuit profile and engineering_report group; simulation selects existing planned stages to stay within its frozen byte budget. update_copilot_stage records model-judged stage status in the circuit/simulation profiles; planned stages are not execution facts and accepted stays non-writable. list_project_extensions is a read-only circuit-profile capability for discovering installed or built-in CDF callback support; it does not register code or execute callbacks. resolve_pdk_baseline performs the user-confirmed sync/keep choice when the workspace and shared standard baselines differ; it does not collect or publish PDK data. Terminal tools are added only when the registered catalog contains them, preserving profile scope for sessions without a qualified terminal. profile_includes is a read-only membership query over this same table so task admission can decide a capability before runtime assembly; it adds no second capability authority. inspect_object and inspect_hierarchy are bounded context readers over the same declared tool table; inspect_hierarchy expands one master level and returns child identities for later inspect_object reads.

Current session resource selection plus registered evidence-only old-journal reconstruction. Latest failed/new-format incomplete inventory is rejected; successful reconstruction freezes a single snapshot and clears legacy candidates.

Current DTO client for agent settings, the separate project agent-mode setting, and structured data-root overrides. Preview source IDs are the documented query contract; epoch/source validation rejects late responses and no mutable backend is exposed. Saves return an explicit outcome and revision.

Current service lifecycle wrapper with registered no-pidfd target support. Only the unreaped direct-child custodian signals, with peer UID/parent/start-time checks; process identity cannot be inferred from a stale PID record. A pre-fork ownership failure is returned through the existing bootstrap channel by service_entry, while the active-thread fork guard remains enforced.
records: Service custody on supported kernels without pidfds

reviews.rationale: Normal conversation continuation delegates to SessionPage. Hidden paused inspect/restore controls are a registered diagnostic contract with scope/authorization/late-receipt checks, not a second normal continuation policy. Recovery visual/shared imports now resolve to sico_ui.visual/shared. Read-only inspection failures and mutating restore failures now use separate notices; structured frontend failures expose the real cause, correlation id and next action without describing a read-only query as an unknown outcome.

Single provider-compatibility table for Responses envelope fields. Profile selection, Codex option derivation and path stripping are one responsibility; stripping only walks registered envelope paths and never reads input or tool payloads.

Current synchronous compatibility entry for one composed visible-DRC check. It creates a temporary service, delegates to the single service.check implementation, and closes the service; it does not introduce a second job, export or Calibre policy.

Sole Codex backend constructor. It rejects non-Codex settings and legacy Python journals before constructing a runtime; no Python fallback or compatibility shim remains. The optional context mode is forwarded to the profile owner so session creation and capability selection use one authority.

Codex-only configuration path resolution, strict JSON reading, environment precedence and CodexSettings construction. Missing configuration is explicit; removed Python and non-Responses providers never fall back.

Single owner of the bounded legacy common.opt fallback parser and override checks. Reference-file mode rejects common.opt rather than maintaining two PDK option sources; the fallback is used only when reference_file is unset and is removed after existing planar projects migrate to star_cmd.

Canonical StarRC input resolver. The legacy-named common-option helper is the only compatibility fallback path; reference-file mode rejects common.opt and routes foundry-owned settings through starrc_reference.py, so there is no duplicate option model.
cadai.mcp remains the single public MCP facade; it lazily re-exports McpServer, TOOLS, the stdio line bound and the environment entry point from cadai.mcp.mcp without duplicating state.

Single owner for the bounded cad.entry.context.v2 L0/L1/L2 source facts and the v1 internal adapter. Native capture remains source-only; build_payload remains the sole model-facing payload projection.
